name: Punch-in on new sentences
oneliner: A subtle zoom-in at the start of each new sentence.
description: Fakes a second camera angle, so one long take feels edited and alive.
prompt: At each sentence start (from transcript punctuation, at least 3s apart), alternate the framing between wide (1.00x) and punched in (1.12-1.18x, centered so the eyes sit near y=700). Use hard cuts for crisp jump-cut energy, or a 200ms ease-out zoom if the profile prefers 'smooth'. Never punch in so far that more than 5% of the top of the head is cropped, and never drop below 1080 wide (on a 1080p source, cap at 1.12x). No punch-ins during b-roll. Do NOT add camera shake and do NOT zoom out past wide.
